projects.title: ML Learning Lab
projects.summary: A hands-on machine learning lab for building AI systems from scratch: neural networks, embeddings, RAG, tiny transformers, model APIs, visualizers, and Marg, an offline Bhagavad Gita desktop assistant. Designed to make model internals visible from raw data to prediction, loss, backpropagation, and deployment.

projects.title: CodeBlockPlay
projects.summary: An interactive learning playground where kids explore coding, puzzles, math, and brain games through fun activities. Designed to make problem-solving and computational thinking engaging through play.

projects.title: HookScore
projects.summary: HookScore is a Chrome extension with a local backend. Upload a draft video or paste a YouTube Shorts URL, then get a Hook Score with clear improvement suggestions.

projects.title: Documint
projects.summary: Documint is a Chrome extension for viewing and editing local Markdown files in a cleaner, more document-friendly way inside the browser.
